title: Adobe’s Local MCP Preview: What Video Editors Can Use Today
summary: Learn which MCP setup works for native Adobe editing now, how Aspect supplies source media, and how to turn approved interview selects into a rough cut you can inspect.
body_markdown:
You can use independent connectors today to work on editable Premiere and After Effects projects, with Aspect supplying footage, transcripts, and review context. Adobe’s newly announced official local MCP preview is not generally available to install.


On November 10, 2026, Adobe previewed local MCP for Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere, and After Effects, with native editable changes and private beta planned for early 2027. That is planned availability, not guaranteed access. See[Adobe’s announcement and demo](https://news.adobe.com/news/2026/11/adobe-transforms-creative-cloud-tools) .


MCP, short for[Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/docs/getting-started/intro) , is a standard that lets an AI assistant discover and use tools exposed by another application or service.


## What native editability means


Instead of receiving advice or a rendered video, you ask an assistant to make supported changes inside your editing application. The result remains a native sequence or composition that you can open, adjust, and continue editing yourself.


Each connector[exposes specific operations](https://premiere-pro-mcp.com/tools/) , not every application command. Choose one that supports your task, and[save a recoverable project version](https://creativemcp.com/docs/getting-started.html) before trying changes.


An in-app Adobe AI Assistant, the hosted Adobe for Creativity connector, and a local MCP acting on a desktop project are separate connections. Access to one does not provide the others. “Local” also describes where the application tools run; it does not guarantee an offline AI model or prevent information from reaching your assistant provider.


November 3 example using the community connector 1.29.0 with CEP. The three generated test clips remain editable on V1 with linked audio on A1. The sequence markers sit at 0, 5, and 10 seconds, and the sequence ends at 15 seconds. The connector’s offline-media check returned zero missing files. This capture does not show the newer UXP connector.


## Choose an editor you can use today


Start with where your work needs to remain editable:


- **Premiere:** The independent connector needs[a local MCP server](https://premiere-pro-mcp.com/what-is-premiere-pro-mcp/) and a matching Premiere panel. Use it for an editable Premiere timeline. Follow the[Premiere MCP guide](https://aspect.inc/blog/post-production/premiere-pro-mcp-editable-timeline) .
- **After Effects:** The independent kumoproductions server uses scripting to work in AE. We recommend it when your task maps to a clear composition structure. Follow the[After Effects MCP guide](https://aspect.inc/blog/post-production/after-effects-mcp-claude-brand-update) .
- **Resolve:** DaVinci Resolve Studio 21.1 includes a native MCP server through **File > Setup AI Assistants** . This is Blackmagic’s integration, not Adobe’s preview. Follow the[Resolve MCP guide](https://aspect.inc/blog/post-production/davinci-resolve-mcp-claude-chatgpt-codex) .


Our November 3 example tested the independent Premiere connector; current setup steps, including local Codex, are based on maintainer documentation, not a newly completed test.


The companion guides cover installation and example results. Use the instructions for your chosen connector rather than combining packages or panels from different projects.


## Choose Claude Desktop or local Codex


Claude Desktop and a local Codex session can launch MCP processes on your editing computer.


For Claude, follow the connector guide alongside[Claude Desktop’s local-server instructions](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/10949351-getting-started-with-local-mcp-servers-on-claude-desktop) .


For the OpenAI route, use Codex in the ChatGPT desktop app or local Codex.[OpenAI’s MCP documentation](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/extend/mcp?surface=cli) covers server registration and` ~/.codex/config.toml` , including` \[mcp_servers.name\]` ,` command` , and` args` . ChatGPT web does not read that local configuration.


These routes connect independently installed tools; neither installs Adobe’s preview. Keep credentials in supported authentication flows or secure configuration, never in prompts or screenshots.


## Bring footage and review context through Aspect


Aspect helps the same assistant[find footage, read transcripts](https://aspect.inc/features/asset-intelligence) , organize selects, and retrieve review notes. The editing application’s connector makes native project changes; Aspect itself does not edit a Premiere sequence or AE composition.


In Aspect, open **Settings > Aspect Agent & MCP** , follow the connection instructions, and sign in. Then ask:


> List the Aspect workspaces and projects I can access.


Choose your project and give the assistant a concrete brief. Request source filenames, transcript excerpts, and time ranges, plus relevant review notes identified by asset or version. See[Aspect’s MCP documentation](https://aspect.inc/docs/mcp/index) and[agentic editing workflow](https://aspect.inc/docs/workflows/agentic-video-editing) .


[Mount the chosen project](https://aspect.inc/docs/instant-access/mount-a-project) in the Aspect desktop app’s drive view so the editor can open original media through Finder or File Explorer. Use those stable source paths. Mounting streams needed bytes;[pinning](https://aspect.inc/docs/instant-access/pin-files) downloads full files and must finish before offline use. If you use proxies, preserve proxy-to-original matching rather than assuming automatic conform.


Illustrative Aspect example. Describe the content you want to see. This example searches the picture rather than relying on the clip's filename.


## A prompt to try: selects into a rough cut


This is a prompt to try, not a completed cross-app test. Replace the project name with yours:


> Use Aspect to find two interview passages about the product launch in the Launch Campaign project, plus supporting B-roll showing the product in use.
>
>
> Propose selects first. For each interview passage, return the source filename, transcript excerpt, source in and out times, and why it fits. For B-roll, include the filename, source range, and what is visible. Retrieve relevant review notes and flag conflicting directions. Wait for me to approve the selects.
>
>
> After approval, use the connected Premiere tools to create a new sequence named Launch_RoughCut_01 from the approved mounted source files. Confirm sequence settings with me first. Leave existing sequences untouched, keep dialogue and B-roll separately editable, and add no music, effects, or generated media. If an operation is unsupported, explain rather than substituting another action.
>
>
> Report what changed.


The first result should be a source-based selects proposal. After approval, the intended result is a new editable sequence. Open it, listen for clipped words, and watch whether the B-roll supports the dialogue. You choose the strongest takes and judge the pacing.


## When Adobe opens its beta


We do not have access to Adobe’s preview. When beta documentation becomes available, use it for supported applications, versions, clients, and tools, not today’s independent connector configuration. Start with a small change in a duplicate sequence or composition. Private beta planned for early 2027 does not establish when you will receive access.


## Common mistakes


**The server connects, but Premiere does not respond.** Check the matching panel and open project. With the independent connector, ask it to run` verify_premiere_connection` .


**Aspect finds a clip, but the editor reports missing media.** Check the mount and source path; repeating the search will not fix file access.


**The request is too broad.** We recommend narrow follow-ups:


> Compare this sequence with the approved selects. Report missing passages or changed source ranges without editing.


> Retrieve review notes for this edit from Aspect and propose revisions, separating explicit requests from your suggestions.


> Propose a tighter opening using only approved footage. Explain the trade-off before creating a new version.


## FAQ


Adobe’s November 10, 2026 announcement describes a preview, not a generally available integration. Adobe says a private beta is planned for early 2027, but that doesn't guarantee access. Independent Premiere and After Effects connectors are separate options with their own installation requirements and supported tools.


The independent Premiere connector described in this guide requires both a local MCP server configured for your assistant and the matching connector panel installed in Premiere. Follow the same connector project’s instructions for both components. Once connected, ask the assistant to run verify_premiere_connection without making changes and identify the open project.


ChatGPT web doesn't read your local Codex configuration. For the workflow described here, use local Codex or Codex in the ChatGPT desktop app with the editor connector configured on the editing computer. Registering a server with Codex doesn't install the editor-side components or provide access to Adobe’s official preview.


Not necessarily. Local describes where the application tools run, not where the AI model processes information. Tool results, transcripts, filenames, or other project details may reach your assistant provider, depending on the connector and configuration. Review the provider’s data settings and your organization’s confidentiality requirements before connecting client work.


Yes, if the connector supports the requested operations, it can make changes in a native sequence or composition rather than returning only a rendered video. Editability doesn't imply support for every application feature. Ask which tools are available, work in a duplicate sequence or composition, and inspect the result in the editor.
